Cross-Platform Usenet Uploader in Go (Windows, Linux, macOS) with a local web interface, streaming upload (< 60 MB RAM), archiving (RAR5 / 7-Zip / native splitting) or unchanged upload, PAR2 creation, NNTP upload, NZB generation, and customizable BBCode posting templates.

### Highlights
- **Two modes:** "Pack and upload" (RAR5 / 7-Zip / native splitting, optional random or manual password) or "Upload only (1:1)" for files you already prepared, including an optional password of your own archive for the NZB.
- **PAR2 recovery files** with ParPar or par2cmdline, always when packing, optional in upload-only mode.
- **Upload check:** After uploading, GoUp asks the news server whether every part arrived and re-checks missing parts. If something is still missing you get a warning and the package is kept for a repeat upload.
- **NZB with password meta**, so SABnzbd / NZBGet unpack automatically; **posting template (.txt)** for movies/series, games or misc, optional.
- **Built-in video parser** (MKV / MP4 / AVI) for MediaInfo without external programs.
- **Privacy:** No telemetry, no update check. Apart from your news server GoUp contacts nobody, unless you switch on the optional online lookup of cover and description (TMDB, TVMaze, DuckDuckGo).
- **Interface in German and English**, including log and error messages; dark design.
- **Light on resources:** streaming upload with less than 60 MB RAM; leftover work folders after a crash are removed at the next start.
- **Security:** local web interface only on 127.0.0.1 with request checks, encrypted storage of the server password, protection against device paths and oversized inputs.

### Verify Downloads
Each file has a matching `.sha256` file (GitHub also shows the SHA-256 digest next to every file).
```bash
sha256sum -c Usenet_GoUp-v1.38.0-linux-x86_64.sha256
```
On Windows: `Get-FileHash .\Usenet_GoUp-v1.38.0-windows-x86_64.exe` and compare with the `.sha256` file.

Windows SmartScreen may warn ("unknown publisher") because the program is not code-signed. After checking the SHA-256, click *More info* → *Run anyway*.

### Build from Source
No third-party Go modules (standard library only), Go 1.27.4 or newer:
```bash
go test ./...
go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -X main.version=v1.38.0" -o usenet-goup .
```
